videos.title: This Green Beach Shouldn't Exist
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
Check out the Rocks Box store and subscribe here!: https://complexly.info/rocks 

There's a beach in Hawaii with green sand, a phenomenon that exists almost nowhere else on Earth. And the geologic events that formed it are as unlikely as the beach itself. 

Hosted by: Denali Kincaid (they/them)

videos.title: Ancient Octopuses Were MUCH Bigger Than We Thought
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
The Cretaceous Period is famous for enormous ocean-dwelling beasts. New research shows it boasted the biggest octopuses, and maybe the biggest invertebrates, of all time.

Hosted by: Savannah Geary (they/them)

videos.title: The Con Man Who Invented Anesthesia
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description: Throughout history, a few men have been associated with the invention of anesthesia. William Morton definitely didn't invent it, but he sure did popularize it. He also tried to disguise the actual chemical he used (ether) and patent it under the name Letheon. All that drama and more in this SciShow

videos.title: When A Shipwreck Comes Back To Life
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
A shipwreck might end a ship's life upon the waves, but once it reaches the sea floor, an entire second life awaits. It turns out that shipwrecks have a rich afterlife, and are more alive than you might think.

Hosted by: Savannah Geary (they/them)
